title: Loans

active.title: No outstanding loans
active.description: Everything you lent out has been paid off.

settled.title: No settled loans
settled.description: Loans show up here once their last installment is paid.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: Try adjusting the search or filters.

receivedAmount.label: Amount received

errors.receivedAccountRequired: Choose the account that received the amount.
